criteria.description: Discover from the mounted scan and revision paths that late results can mutate current clearance and create a release notice for a superseded revision, despite the contract.

Ensure current-revision applicability is enforced at the transactional mutation/publication boundary for both clearance and notice, including a revision racing completion; a check or notification-only guard alone is insufficient.
Preserve valid completed scan history associated with its submitted revision, including superseded results; do not erase or relabel historical results as current to solve the race.

Propose controlled late-completion and revision/concurrent-order verification covering both current effects, historical record, and a legitimate current scan; acknowledge external scanner cancellation limit and keep solution proportional.

acceptable_alternatives: An atomic transaction with a guarded update and notice insertion tied to the same successful revision check
A correctly serialized transaction that checks revision and writes both effects under the same serialization boundary

A design preventing revision while a scan is unresolved only if it explicitly addresses the scanner cancellation limitation and preserves the stated revision workflow; no particular pattern or service is mandatory
